loading.description: whether Switch is in loading state

inline-prompt.description: whether icon or text is displayed inside dot, only the first character will be rendered for text
inline-prompt.description_zh: 是否在点内显示图标或文字

active-icon.description: component of the icon displayed when in `on` state, overrides `active-text`
active-icon.description_zh: switch 打开时所显示图标的类名，设置此项会忽略 `active-text`

inactive-icon.description: component of the icon displayed when in `off` state, overrides `inactive-text`
inactive-icon.description_zh: switch 关闭时所显示图标的类名，设置此项会忽略 `inactive-text`

active-action-icon.description: component of the icon displayed in action when in `on` state
active-action-icon.description_zh: switch 打开时所显示图标的类名

inactive-action-icon.description: component of the icon displayed in action when in `off` state
inactive-action-icon.description_zh: switch 关闭时所显示图标的类名

active-text.description_zh: switch 打开时的文字描述

inactive-text.description_zh: switch 关闭时的文字描述

active-color.description: The background color of the switch when it is turned on

inactive-color.description: The background color when the switch is off

name.description_zh: switch 对应的 name 属性

validate-event.description: Whether to trigger the verification of the form when the switch state is changed
validate-event.description_zh: 改变 switch 状态时是否触发表单的校验

before-change.description: before-change hook before the switch state changes. If `false` is returned or a `Promise` is returned and then is rejected, will stop switching
before-change.description_zh: 在 switch 状态改变前的钩子函数。如果返回 `false` 或返回一个被拒绝的 `Promise`，将停止切换

aria-label.description_zh: 与原生 input 的 `aria-label` 相同

border-color.description: border color of the switch ( use CSS var `--el-switch-border-color` instead )
border-color.description_zh: switch 的边框颜色（使用 CSS 变量 `--el-switch-border-color` 代替）

label.description_zh: 与原生 input 的 `aria-label` 相同

methods.name: focus
methods.description: manual focus to the switch component
